Transport Documents

Yük Teslim İzni

An official authorization or document, usually issued by a carrier or customs authority, permitting the consignee to take possession of cargo at destination after all contractual and regulatory conditions are satisfied.

Kisa cevap: An official authorization or document, usually issued by a carrier or customs authority, permitting the consignee to take possession of cargo at destination after all contractual and regulatory conditions are satisfied.

Yük Teslim İzni nedir?

Bu sozlukte Yük Teslim İzni su sekilde aciklanir: An official authorization or document, usually issued by a carrier or customs authority, permitting the consignee to take possession of cargo at destination after all contractual and regulatory conditions are satisfied.

Yük Teslim İzni lojistik alaninda nasil kullanilir?

Lojistik iletisiminde bu terim su baglamlarda kullanilir: "Alıcı, gümrük işlemleri ve tüm ücretlerin ödenmesinin ardından terminal girişinde yük teslim iznini ibraz etmelidir."

Yük Teslim İzni lojistik alaninda neden onemlidir?

Yük Teslim İzni, Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, ve Customs Brokers icin Transport Documents baglamlarinda daha net iletisim kurmaya yardimci oldugu icin onemlidir. Ayrica FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, ve IATA DGR gibi egitim ve sinav dilleriyle bag kurar.

Yük Teslim İzni kimler tarafindan kullanilir?

Yük Teslim İzni agirlikli olarak Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, ve Customs Brokers tarafindan kullanilir.

Yük Teslim İzni hangi kategoriye aittir?

Bu sozlukte Yük Teslim İzni, Transport Documents kategorisi altinda yer alir. Bu kategori yakin prosedurleri, komutlari ve operasyonel kavramlari bir araya getirir.

Bu tanim hangi kaynaga dayanir?

Bu tanim Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO kaynaklarina dayanir ve Protermify Logistics tarafindan statik lojistik referansi olarak yayinlanir.

Tanim

An official authorization or document, usually issued by a carrier or customs authority, permitting the consignee to take possession of cargo at destination after all contractual and regulatory conditions are satisfied.

Kullanim ornegi

The consignee must present a cargo release at the terminal gate to collect goods after customs clearance and payment of all charges.
